1→import re
     2→
     3→from fastapi import APIRouter, UploadFile, File, HTTPException
     4→
     5→from app.database import db
     6→
     7→router = APIRouter(prefix="/api", tags=["tables"])
     8→
     9→
    10→def sanitize_table_name(filename: str) -> str:
    11→    base = re.sub(r"\.csv$", "", filename, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
    12→    sanitized = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9_]", "_", base.lower())
    13→    sanitized = re.sub(r"^[^a-z]", lambda m: "t_" + m.group(), sanitized)
    14→    sanitized = re.sub(r"_+", "_", sanitized).rstrip("_")
    15→    return sanitized or "table"
    16→
    17→
    18→@router.get("/tables")
    19→async def list_tables():
    20→    return db.list_tables()
    21→
    22→
    23→@router.post("/upload")
    24→async def upload_csv(file: UploadFile = File(...)):
    25→    if not file.filename or not file.filename.lower().endswith(".csv"):
    26→        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Only CSV files are supported")
    27→    content = await file.read()
    28→    table_name = sanitize_table_name(file.filename)
    29→    result = db.load_csv(content, file.filename, table_name)
    30→    return result
    31→
    32→
    33→@router.post("/upload/sample")
    34→async def load_sample():
    35→    """Load the built-in Titanic sample dataset."""
    36→    import urllib.request
    37→    import tempfile
    38→    import os
    39→
    40→    sample_url = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/datasciencedojo/datasets/master/titanic.csv"
    41→    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".csv", delete=False) as tmp:
    42→        urllib.request.urlretrieve(sample_url, tmp.name)
    43→        tmp_path = tmp.name
    44→    try:
    45→        result = db.load_sample_data(tmp_path, "titanic")
    46→    finally:
    47→        os.unlink(tmp_path)
    48→    return result
    49→
    50→
    51→@router.delete("/tables/{table_name}")
    52→async def drop_table(table_name: str):
    53→    db.drop_table(table_name)
    54→    return {"ok": True}

   663→import type { ToolCallResult } from '../types';
   664→
   665→interface AgentCallbacks {
   666→  onTextChunk: (text: string) => void;
   667→  onToolCall: (toolCallId: string, sql: string) => void;
   668→  onToolResult: (result: ToolCallResult) => void;
   669→  onDone: (sessionId: string | null) => void;
   670→  onError: (error: string) => void;
   671→}
   672→
   673→export async function runAgentLoop(
   674→  message: string,
   675→  sessionId: string | null,
   676→  callbacks: AgentCallbacks,
   677→  signal?: AbortSignal,
   678→): Promise<void> {
   679→  try {
   680→    const response = await fetch('/api/chat', {
   681→      method: 'POST',
   682→      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
   683→      body: JSON.stringify({ message, session_id: sessionId }),
   684→      signal,
   685→    });
   686→
   687→    if (!response.ok) {
   688→      const errorText = await response.text();
   689→      callbacks.onError(`Server error: ${errorText}`);
   690→      return;
   691→    }
   692→
   693→    const reader = response.body?.getReader();
   694→    if (!reader) {
   695→      callbacks.onError('No response stream');
   696→      return;
   697→    }
   698→
   699→    const decoder = new TextDecoder();
   700→    let buffer = '';
   701→
   702→    while (true) {
   703→      const { done, value } = await reader.read();
   704→      if (done) break;
   705→
   706→      buffer += decoder.decode(value, { stream: true });
   707→      const lines = buffer.split('\n');
   708→      buffer = lines.pop() ?? '';
   709→
   710→      let eventType = '';
   711→      for (const line of lines) {
   712→        if (line.startsWith('event: ')) {
   713→          eventType = line.slice(7).trim();
   714→        } else if (line.startsWith('data: ')) {
   715→          const data = line.slice(6);
   716→          try {
   717→            const parsed = JSON.parse(data);
   718→            handleSSEEvent(eventType, parsed, callbacks);
   719→          } catch {
   720→            // Skip malformed JSON
   721→          }
   722→          eventType = '';
   723→        }
   724→      }
   725→    }
   726→  } catch (e: unknown) {
   727→    if (signal?.aborted) return;
   728→    const msg = e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Connection failed';
   729→    callbacks.onError(msg);
   730→  }
   731→}
   732→
   733→function handleSSEEvent(
   734→  eventType: string,
   735→  data: Record<string, unknown>,
   736→  callbacks: AgentCallbacks,
   737→) {
   738→  switch (eventType) {
   739→    case 'thinking':
   740→    case 'answer':
   741→      callbacks.onTextChunk(data.text as string);
   742→      break;
   743→    case 'tool_call':
   744→      callbacks.onToolCall(data.id as string, data.sql as string);
   745→      break;
   746→    case 'tool_result': {
   747→      // Parse tool result from agent
   748→      const result: ToolCallResult = {
   749→        toolCallId: (data.id as string) ?? '',
   750→        sql: '',
   751→        columns: [],
   752→        rows: [],
   753→        rowCount: 0,
   754→      };
   755→      // Try to extract structured data from content
   756→      const content = data.content as string;
   757→      if (content) {
   758→        // The tool result content is text - we display it as metadata
   759→        // The actual structured results come from the execute_sql tool
   760→      }
   761→      callbacks.onToolResult(result);
   762→      break;
   763→    }
   764→    case 'done':
   765→      callbacks.onDone((data.session_id as string) ?? null);
   766→      break;
   767→    case 'error':
   768→      callbacks.onError((data.message as string) ?? 'Unknown error');
   769→      break;
   770→  }
   771→}

1→import duckdb
     2→import os
     3→import tempfile
     4→from typing import Any
     5→
     6→
     7→class Database:
     8→    def __init__(self):
     9→        self.conn = duckdb.connect(":memory:")
    10→
    11→    def execute_query(self, sql: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    12→        """Execute a SQL query and return results as dict with columns, rows, rowCount."""
    13→        result = self.conn.execute(sql)
    14→        columns = [desc[0] for desc in result.description] if result.description else []
    15→        rows = [dict(zip(columns, row)) for row in result.fetchall()] if columns else []
    16→        return {"columns": columns, "rows": rows, "rowCount": len(rows)}
    17→
    18→    def load_csv(self, file_bytes: bytes, filename: str, table_name: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    19→        """Load a CSV file into a DuckDB table. Returns table info."""
    20→        with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".csv", delete=False) as tmp:
    21→            tmp.write(file_bytes)
    22→            tmp_path = tmp.name
    23→        try:
    24→            self.conn.execute(
    25→                f'CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "{table_name}" AS SELECT * FROM read_csv_auto(\'{tmp_path}\')'
    26→            )
    27→        finally:
    28→            os.unlink(tmp_path)
    29→        return self.get_table_info(table_name)
    30→
    31→    def get_table_info(self, table_name: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    32→        """Get info about a specific table."""
    33→        cols_result = self.conn.execute(f'DESCRIBE "{table_name}"')
    34→        columns = [
    35→            {"name": row[0], "type": row[1]}
    36→            for row in cols_result.fetchall()
    37→        ]
    38→        count_result = self.conn.execute(f'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "{table_name}"')
    39→        row_count = count_result.fetchone()[0]
    40→        return {"name": table_name, "columns": columns, "rowCount": row_count}
    41→
    42→    def list_tables(self) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    43→        """List all tables with their schema info."""
    44→        tables_result = self.conn.execute("SHOW TABLES")
    45→        table_names = [row[0] for row in tables_result.fetchall()]
    46→        return [self.get_table_info(name) for name in table_names]
    47→
    48→    def drop_table(self, table_name: str) -> None:
    49→        """Drop a table."""
    50→        self.conn.execute(f'DROP TABLE IF EXISTS "{table_name}"')
    51→
    52→    def load_sample_data(self, csv_path: str, table_name: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    53→        """Load sample CSV from a file path."""
    54→        self.conn.execute(
    55→            f'CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "{table_name}" AS SELECT * FROM read_csv_auto(\'{csv_path}\')'
    56→        )
    57→        return self.get_table_info(table_name)

1→# DuckDB Data Agent
     2→
     3→> **Note:** This project is built with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/product/claude-code)(using Opus 4.6 and [superpowers](https://github.com/obra/superpowers)) by more than 95% and human-reviewed by author.
     4→
     5→[![Deploy to Render](https://render.com/images/deploy-to-render-button.svg)](https://render.com/deploy)
     6→
     7→A SQL playground with an AI-powered data analysis agent. Upload CSV files, write SQL queries, or ask questions in plain English — powered by [DuckDB](https://duckdb.org/) on a lightweight [FastAPI](https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/) backend with a React frontend.
     8→
     9→## Features
    10→
    11→### SQL Playground
    12→
    13→- **DuckDB SQL engine** — Fast, in-process analytical database on the backend
    14→- **CSV file upload** — Drag-and-drop or click to import CSV files (up to 500 MB) with automatic schema detection
    15→- **Sample dataset** — One-click load of the Titanic dataset to get started quickly
    16→- **SQL query editor** — Write and execute queries with Ctrl/Cmd+Enter
    17→- **Interactive results** — Sortable columns, per-column filters, and global search across results
    18→- **EXPLAIN support** — Markdown-rendered output for `EXPLAIN` and `EXPLAIN ANALYZE` queries
    19→- **Table sidebar** — Collapsible panel to browse tables, inspect columns, and view types
    20→
    21→### AI Agent
    22→
    23→- **Natural language queries** — Ask questions about your data in plain English; the agent writes and executes SQL for you
    24→- **Streaming responses** — Real-time token streaming powered by Claude via the [Anthropic Agent SDK](https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python)
    25→- **Visible reasoning** — Collapsible thinking block shows the agent's intermediate steps and SQL queries
    26→- **Inline results** — Query results rendered inline within the conversation
    27→- **Privacy-conscious** — Requires an Anthropic API key stored in a server-side `.env` file; your data and key are never sent anywhere besides the Anthropic API
    28→
    29→## Getting Started
    30→
    31→### Prerequisites
    32→
    33→- [Node.js](https://nodejs.org/) 20+
    34→- [Python](https://www.python.org/) 3.12+
    35→- [Poetry](https://python-poetry.org/)
    36→
    37→### Installation
    38→
    39→```bash
    40→make install
    41→```
    42→
    43→Or install frontend and backend separately:
    44→
    45→```bash
    46→cd frontend && npm install
    47→cd backend && poetry install
    48→```
    49→
    50→### Configuration
    51→
    52→Copy the example environment file and add your Anthropic API key:
    53→
    54→```bash
    55→cp backend/.env.example backend/.env
    56→```
    57→
    58→Edit `backend/.env` and set your key:
    59→
    60→```
    61→ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-ant-...
    62→```
    63→
    64→> The API key is only needed for the AI agent. The SQL playground works without it, but both require the backend running.
    65→
    66→### Development
    67→
    68→Start both the frontend and backend:
    69→
    70→```bash
    71→make dev
    72→```
    73→
    74→Or run them separately:
    75→
    76→```bash
    77→make frontend   # http://localhost:5173
    78→make backend    # http://localhost:8000
    79→```
    80→
    81→Open http://localhost:5173 to use the app. The Vite dev server proxies `/api` requests to the backend automatically.
    82→
    83→## Production Build and Deployment
    84→
    85→The project ships as a single Docker image that bundles the React frontend and FastAPI backend. A multi-stage `Dockerfile` builds the frontend, then copies the output into the backend's static directory.
    86→
    87→### Build and run locally
    88→
    89→```bash
    90→docker build -t duckdb-data-agent .
    91→docker run -p 10000:10000 -e ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-ant-... duckdb-data-agent
    92→```
    93→
    94→Open http://localhost:10000 to use the app.
    95→
    96→### Deploy to Render
    97→
    98→A `render.yaml` is included for one-click deployment on [Render](https://render.com/):
    99→
   100→1. Push this repo to GitHub.
   101→2. In Render, create a new **Blueprint** and connect the repo.
   102→3. Set the `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` environment variable in the Render dashboard.
   103→
   104→Render will build the Docker image and deploy it automatically on every push to `main`.
   105→
   106→## Project Structure
   107→
   108→```
   109→├── frontend/               # React frontend
   110→│   ├── src/
   111→│   │   ├── components/     #   UI components (editor, results, sidebar, chat)
   112→│   │   ├── agent/          #   Agent service (SSE event handling)
   113→│   │   ├── AgentContext.tsx #   Agent state management
   114→│   │   └── types.ts        #   Shared TypeScript interfaces
   115→│   ├── public/             #   Static assets (sample dataset)
   116→│   ├── index.html          #   HTML entry point
   117→│   ├── package.json        #   npm config
   118→│   └── vite.config.ts      #   Vite bundler config
   119→├── backend/                # FastAPI backend
   120→│   └── app/
   121→│       ├── main.py         #   App setup & CORS
   122→│       ├── database.py     #   DuckDB connection & query execution
   123→│       ├── agent.py        #   Agent loop & SSE streaming
   124→│       ├── tools.py        #   MCP tool definitions
   125→│       └── routes/         #   API endpoints (tables, query, chat)
   126→└── Makefile                # Dev commands (install, dev, clean)
   127→```
   128→
   129→## Tech Stack
   130→
   131→**Frontend**
   132→- [React](https://react.dev/) 18 + [TypeScript](https://www.typescriptlang.org/)
   133→- [Vite](https://vite.dev/)
   134→

   136→- [FastAPI](https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/) + [Uvicorn](https://www.uvicorn.org/)
   137→- [DuckDB](https://duckdb.org/) (Python)
   138→- [Anthropic Agent SDK](https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python)

import re

from fastapi import APIRouter, UploadFile, File, HTTPException

from app.database import db

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api", tags=["tables"])


def sanitize_table_name(filename: str) -> str:
    base = re.sub(r"\.csv$", "", filename, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
    sanitized = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9_]", "_", base.lower())
    sanitized = re.sub(r"^[^a-z]", lambda m: "t_" + m.group(), sanitized)
    sanitized = re.sub(r"_+", "_", sanitized).rstrip("_")
    return sanitized or "table"


@router.get("/tables")
async def list_tables():
    return db.list_tables()


@router.post("/upload")
async def upload_csv(file: UploadFile = File(...)):
    if not file.filename or not file.filename.lower().endswith(".csv"):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Only CSV files are supported")
    content = await file.read()
    table_name = sanitize_table_name(file.filename)
    result = db.load_csv(content, file.filename, table_name)
    return result


@router.post("/upload/sample")
async def load_sample():
    """Load the built-in Titanic sample dataset."""
    import urllib.request
    import tempfile
    import os

    sample_url = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/datasciencedojo/datasets/master/titanic.csv"
    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".csv", delete=False) as tmp:
        urllib.request.urlretrieve(sample_url, tmp.name)
        tmp_path = tmp.name
    try:
        result = db.load_sample_data(tmp_path, "titanic")
    finally:
        os.unlink(tmp_path)
    return result


@router.delete("/tables/{table_name}")
async def drop_table(table_name: str):
    db.drop_table(table_name)
    return {"ok": True}
